outcome: Maternal and newborn innate cytokine responses (IL-8, IL-6, pro-inflammatory, TH1, TH17)
cohort: 48 mother-infant pairs from southern Mozambique (35 HIV-uninfected and 13 HIV-infected mothers).
finding: HIV-infected women not receiving antiretroviral therapy (ART) before pregnancy showed decreased IL-8 and IL-6 responses in peripheral and cord blood, and increased pro-inflammatory, TH1, and TH17 responses in placental blood compared to HIV-uninfected women.
